title: Choose a new password
purpose: Choose a new password after an administrator marked yours as compromised, before you go on to anything else.
summary: An administrator marked your password as compromised. Choose a new one here; until you do, this session opens only this page.

tasks.title: Choose a new password
steps: Type a new password in [[New password]] and again in [[New password confirmation]]. The rule for your account is listed under the first field.
Select [[Save new password]]. You go on to the page you were opening when you signed in, or to the start page.

tasks.title: Leave without changing it
steps: Select [[Sign out]]. Your password still does not sign you in on its own, and you come back here at your next sign-in.

good_to_know: You do not type your current password: it is the one marked, and you proved who you are with your authenticator code or an emailed sign-in code.
The marked password cannot be chosen again. Choose one you have not used anywhere else.
Your other sessions ended when the password was marked; this one stays signed in after you save.
A shared demonstration account cannot change its password here. Sign out and use another account.

sections.title: Why you are here
paragraphs: A superuser of your laboratory marked your account's password as compromised in the admin console: someone else may know it. Why it is needed gives the date and time of the mark; who made it and the reason they recorded are not shown here.

A marked password no longer signs you in on its own. You reached this page because your sign-in also used your authenticator app (or a recovery code) or a sign-in code emailed to your address. A sign-in with the password alone is signed out at once, with a notice on the sign-in page.

items.label: New password
items.description: Required. Checked against the laboratory's password rule for your account, listed under the field: at least 15 characters, or 8 where the laboratory requires a second sign-in factor of your account; not a common or expected password; not too similar to your username, names or email address; and not a password marked as compromised for your account, now or before.

items.label: New password confirmation
items.description: Required. Type the same password again; the two must match.

items.label: Save new password
items.description: Saves the new password, which lifts the mark, and goes on to the first page you opened in the window after signing in, or the start page. If the mark was lifted meanwhile (a new password set elsewhere), nothing is saved and you go on. If your session ended meanwhile, nothing is saved and you are signed out.

items.label: Sign out
items.description: Ends this session. Nothing changes; the mark stays until a new password is saved.

sections.title: What this session can open
paragraphs: Until a new password is saved, this session opens only this page, Sign out and the session's own status (the warning before a sign-out and Stay signed in). Any other page, form, dialog or file sends you back here, and the menu, Find, What's new and the other account pages are not shown. If the laboratory also requires a second sign-in factor of your account and it has none, you set that up first.

Once the new password is saved, everything your roles allow opens again. The save ends every other session of your account and keeps this one. The change is recorded in the audit history without the password.

sections.title: Other ways to replace the password
paragraphs: A new password chosen through Forgot your password? on the sign-in page, where the laboratory sends email, also lifts the mark, and so does a password a superuser sets for your account in the admin console. Signing in with the new password then works as usual.
